title: PDF Stock Manager
summary: Stock management tool using JavaScript embedded in a PDF form, built for a Windows XP machine on a factory floor where no software installation was allowed.
highlights: Zero-install solution: interactive stock tracking delivered as a single PDF file on a locked-down Windows XP system
Automatic inventory calculations using Acrobat JavaScript API -- received minus used equals current stock
Engineering under constraints: creative problem-solving when modern tools are not an option
